title: MEIKO — Happy Anniversary!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Weekend Garage
Stage

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Alright...
We don't have much time today, so let's call it here for now.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, it is MEIKO's anniversary after all.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, we gotta head over to SEKAI after this.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, but there's something I need to see before we go...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: See what...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, right!
MEIKO's anniversary show!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, you mean this MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Now I remember. You told me about it the other day, Azusawa.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Actually, Ichika's the one who told me about it.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, good! It just started!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane, lemme see too!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Now that I think about it, I'm not sure I've actually seen one of this MEIKO's shows before.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah.
Since we're here, wanna check it out?
VIRTUAL SINGER Stage

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<Hello, everyone in the audience!
And hello to everyone watching the stream!>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Thank you for coming to my anniversary show!>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <I'd like to start with this song...!>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: This MEIKO's really cheerful, but it has so much power too! Like a big sister you can really count on!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, her energy's so infectious. Also, songs with a more mature theme to them really suit her.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I know, right?! And the way she does duets with KAITO's so cool!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Really makes you think...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: How?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: About SEKAI, “Untitled”, MEIKO, the others and how we can actually talk to them whenever we go and visit.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I mean, nothing about that's normal.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, but at the same time, all we can really do is accept as reality, right?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No, I get that. It's just...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I still don't really understand everything behind what you mentioned, but I'm really glad that I got to meet MEIKO and everyone else...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I wouldn't be here talking with you guys right now if I hadn't.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And before, when it came to “VIRTUAL SINGERS”, I knew that they sang songs and stuff...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But now, I'm close enough with them to want to celebrate their anniversaries, almost like we're family.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, I get what you mean!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We've become familiar with MEIKO from SEKAI and she's probably a little different from this MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But MEIKO's still MEIKO wherever you go, so it's hard not to cheer for her!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, true.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I agree. She really has been a great friend to us.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Look at all the comments everybody left while watching the stream, MEIKO.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Oh wow! So many comments...>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Whoa! There's too many to look at all at once!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Yeah... Oh, “MEIKO's so pretty!”
And... “Does she ever not look good in red?!”>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<Really? That's so sweet of them!
Please, feel free to keep posting more!>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, I think I'll write one too!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Great idea!
Can you write one for me too, Kohane?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Sure!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I have to think they're getting a party ready in SEKAI too.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, we should probably head over once this stream's done.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wait, did you remember to get what you were talking about?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You mean our frying pan fundraiser? Way ahead of you! We got that thing ages ago!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I hope she likes it since she's been saying how her current one's been developing some burnt spots.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Right. It's the same one Ken likes to use, so I'm sure we made a good choice...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But it's hard not to feel anxious when you're about to give a gift to someone.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That was a great show...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, but the party hasn't even gotten started for us.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Right! So, shall we?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah! Let's give MEIKO the best celebration we can today!
